caption: Caption
caption help: Shown below the image on the site.
display help: Also adjustable directly in the editor: drag the image handles to resize, use the buttons above the image to align.
external links should start with http://: External links should start with http:// or https://
nofollow help: Tells search engines not to pass any ranking credit (SEO) to the target site.
noopener help: Prevents the opened page from accessing this page via window.opener. Recommended with "Open in new window".
noreferrer help: The target site will not know the visitor came from your site (no Referer header). Also implies noopener.
obf help: The link is hidden from search engines: rendered on the site as an encoded clickable block instead of a real link.
sponsored help: Marks a paid, partnership or affiliate link. Required by Google for any compensated link.
title: Title
toc minimum note: The table of contents only appears on the site with 3 or more headings (H2).
which placeholder block do you want to a: Which Placeholder Block do you want to add
